description: One room, most of it window. A counting desk runs the length of the glass with the repeater board on it, a slate, a stamp, a tin of the stamp's ink and a mug. Pinned along the back wall: the plate ratings, a tariff of fines, and a curling notice about what may and may not be weighed on a public bridge, all three of them printed in the same municipal grey. It is very warm in here and the window is running with it.

window.description: A long sheet of glass at cab height, angled down so the booth can read a windscreen without leaving the chair. Everything on the plates is in it, very close.
window.name: the booth glass

name: The Glacis Weigh — Booth
